note: Sudoku seeds the visual family; Sokoban and Minesweeper use it as their style reference. Large originals remain in local generation evidence; shipping assets are normalized 64x64 four-level PNGs.

prompts.sudoku: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: one Sudoku game launcher icon for PicoNano 684x1216 monochrome e-ink reader. Draw ONE centered icon on pure white, square canvas. A bold compact 3 by 3 Sudoku number-grid symbol with a few clear chunky digits 1, 3, 7 and empty squares, black outside border, grid lines and a short dark-gray lower-right pixel extrusion. Front-facing orthographic, no perspective tilt. Authentic pixel art on a 32x32 logical grid, enlarged with clean nearest-neighbor pixels; no antialiasing. Four neutral values only: black, dark gray, light gray, white. Confident thick clusters, stepped corners, legible at 128x128 display size. Fill about 80 percent of the square, equal white margins, simple strong silhouette. No rounded app badge, no text labels, no words, no logos, no background scenery, no gradients, no noisy dithering, no watercolor. This is the seed of a matching family of 3 game launcher icons.
